rules.title: Rule 1: The Formula
rules.explainA: This is the thing that DID NOT happen in the past.
rules.explainB: This is the imaginary result that WOULD HAVE happened.
rules.teacherNote: We use 'had had' if the main verb is 'have' (e.g., If I had had money).

rules.title: Rule 2: Starting with 'Had'
rules.exampleA: If he had come early, he would have eaten.
rules.exampleB: Had he come early, he would have eaten.
rules.explainA: This is the regular way to start the sentence.
rules.explainB: You can remove 'If' and start with 'Had' to sound more formal.
rules.teacherNote: Both sentences mean exactly the same thing!
